⚠️ للبالغين من عمر 18 سنة فأكثر. مؤشر كت: ⚠️ For adults aged 18 and over. Body mass index is a general estimate and is not accurate for athletes, bodybuilders, pregnant women and older adults. Consult a doctor or a nutritionist.
تعتبر منظمة الصحة العالمية أن مؤشر كتلة: The World Health Organization considers a body mass index (BMI) of 18.5 to 24.9 to be the normal range for adults.
الوزن = BMI × (الطول بالمتر)². فنحسب أقل: Weight = BMI × (height in metres)². So we calculate the lowest and highest weight in this range for your height.
25 – 29.9 زيادة وزن، و30 فأكثر سمنة، وأق: 25 – 29.9 is overweight, 30 and above is obesity, and below 18.5 is underweight.
المؤشر لا يفرّق بين العضلات والدهون، فقد: The index doesn't distinguish between muscle and fat, so an athlete may show as overweight while being in excellent health.
لا يوجد رقم واحد، بل مدى صحي. حسب منظمة: There is no single number, but a healthy range. According to the World Health Organization, a weight that gives a BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered normal for adults.
BMI = weight in kg ÷ height in metres squared. For example 70 kg and height 1.75 m: 70 ÷ 3.06 ≈ 22.9.
هل المدى نفسه للرجال والنساء؟: Is the range the same for men and women?
المدى المعتمد للبالغين هو نفسه، لكن نسبة: The accepted range for adults is the same, but normal body-fat percentage differs, which is why a specialist's advice is more accurate than the number alone.
هل هذه الحاسبة بديل عن الطبيب؟: Is this calculator a substitute for a doctor?
لا، هي تقدير عام. لخطة إنقاص أو زيادة وز: No, it is a general estimate. For a weight-loss or weight-gain plan, see a doctor or a nutritionist.
